blocks.raw: ## Loyalty Customers
blocks.text: Loyalty Customers

blocks.raw:
> \[!WARNING]
> **Possible missing external IDs:**
> When you import new customer profiles, external ID generation may fail if all candidate IDs (when automatic External ID generation runs, the system generates a candidate ID) within the retry limit are already present, or if the maximum external ID in the database does not match the required prefix or suffix. In these cases, new customers may be created without external IDs. This can cause downstream integration failures or missing customer records in connected systems. Always review import reports for missing external IDs and resolve any issues before relying on the imported data.
blocks.text:
[!WARNING]
Possible missing external IDs:
When you import new customer profiles, external ID generation may fail if all candidate IDs (when automatic External ID generation runs, the system generates a candidate ID) within the retry limit are already present, or if the maximum external ID in the database does not match the required prefix or suffix. In these cases, new customers may be created without external IDs. This can cause downstream integration failures or missing customer records in connected systems. Always review import reports for missing external IDs and resolve any issues before relying on the imported data.

blocks.raw: This profile is used to manage loyalty customers - add new customers or update existing customers' profiles. Apart from the standard fields specified below, you can also add custom field values and customer-level extended field values. The CSV file of loyalty customers should contain the following fields.

blocks.raw: > **Note:** The Loyalty Customers import profile updates standard customer fields and custom fields. It does not update tracker values. To import tracker data, use the [Trackers import profile](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/other-import-profiles#trackers) instead. Note that the Trackers profile supports only `bill` and `lineitem` tracker types; importing with a `points` tracker type will fail with an "Invalid tracker type" error.
blocks.text: Note: The Loyalty Customers import profile updates standard customer fields and custom fields. It does not update tracker values. To import tracker data, use the Trackers import profile instead. Note that the Trackers profile supports only bill and lineitem tracker types; importing with a points tracker type will fail with an "Invalid tracker type" error.

blocks.raw:
> \[!IMPORTANT]
> **External ID validation:**
> When you import loyalty customers, the system strictly enforces the External ID prefix and length as configured in your organization settings (Org Settings > Registration). Only External IDs that match the required prefix (for example, LM\*) and length (for example, 10 digits) are accepted. Records with External IDs that do not meet these requirements will be rejected during import.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Note

  If points ledger is enabled, the import process creates an OPENING_BALANCE entry for each imported customer. For non-loyalty customers without a valid CPS_ID, the system assigns cps_id = -1. Importing multiple non-loyalty customers can create duplicate (org_id, cps_id, entry_type, event_log_id) combinations, which causes a unique constraint violation. As a result, the import job fails with an ERR_IMPORT_POINTS_LEDGER_INSERT error.

  If you encounter this error, verify that the import file contains only valid loyalty customers when points ledger is enabled.
</Callout>

blocks.raw: ## User Subscription (Subscription Service New)
blocks.text: User Subscription (Subscription Service New)

blocks.raw: This profile is used to update the status of the subscription of customers for different channels. You can only use mobile numbers and email IDs that are registered in the org. Extended fields update also has Replay option - When an import job is failed to upload from the temporary database to the main database for some reason, the system retries to upload for up to three times, until successful upload. If the import fails even then, you have an option to manually retry in the import details using Click to Replay on the Import File Details page. This option is available for up to seven days.

Extended fields update also has Replay option - When an import job is failed to upload from the temporary database to the main database for some reason, the system retries to upload for up to three times, until successful upload. If the import fails even then, you have an option to manually retry in the import details using Click to Replay on the Import File Details page. This option is available for up to seven days.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="🚧" theme="warn">
  **Note**

  Updates made using the Subscription Service import template with `orgUnitId = -1` apply to non-InStore source profiles and do not update the InStore profile’s subscription status in the users table. The Members export template derives subscription data specifically from the InStore profile. As a result, when subscriptions are updated using `orgUnitId = -1`, the Members export may continue to display outdated or `NOT-SET` subscription values, even though the subscription was successfully updated for other profiles.
</Callout>

Field Description
Account Name Required for channels with multiple accounts.
Org Unit or Concept Code Concept code or org unit code for which you want to update subscription details.
Comm Channel\* The communication channel for which you need to update customer subscription status. Supported values: line, mobile, email, whatsapp, ios, android, postmail, mobilePush
Priority\* Type of message to update status. Supported values: TRANS, BULK
Sub Status\* The new status of the channel. Supported values: OPTIN, OPTOUT
Mobile\* \* Mobile number of the customer. This is required if Select the user input type in _Template Configuration is Mobile._
External ID\*\* External ID of the customer. This is required if Select the user input type in Template Configuration is External_ID.
User ID\*\* User ID of the customer. This is required if Select the user input type in Template Configuration is User_ID.
Email\*\* Email ID of the customer. This is required if Select the user input type in Template Configuration is Email.
